summary: acer aspire 7 gaming system experiencing performance issues with graphics-intensive applications due to outdated hardware and lack of driver updates.
detected_fault: Aging AMD Radeon HD 7350 graphics card not meeting modern benchmarks, causing flickering background in Photoshop, lag and low frame rates in video games, and inability to run demanding 3D animation software like ZBrush.
suggested_solution: Upgrade to a more modern graphics card that meets the demands of 3D animation software, install drivers from AMD or Nvidia directly, and consider upgrading RAM and processor for improved overall performance.
